name: normalize-slug
summary: Implement a small slug normalizer against fixed acceptance tests.
planning_instructions: Plan a correct implementation for normalize_slug in app.py. The fixed acceptance tests require lowercase words, one hyphen for every run of non-alphanumeric characters, no leading or trailing hyphen, and an empty string when no words remain.
implementation_instructions: Implement normalize_slug in app.py without changing the acceptance tests.

strategies.name: minimal
strategies.instructions: Implement the smallest clear solution that satisfies every acceptance test.

strategies.name: defensive
strategies.instructions: Implement a defensive solution with explicit handling for empty and noisy input.

strategies.name: readable
strategies.instructions: Prioritize readability, standard-library usage, and easy maintenance.

strategies.name: focused
strategies.instructions: Use a focused implementation with no unrelated refactoring.
